title: Carlson's 1995 Warren Wilson College lectures proposing a Younger Dryas impact

tellings.quote: I gave re five lectures at Warren Wilson College in 1995. I believe it was [clears throat] where I basically talked about the younger dus, the mass extinctions, the rapid climate change.

plain: In 1995, at Warren Wilson College in North Carolina, a set of lectures argued that a space impact caused the Younger Dryas, a sudden return to ice-age cold near the end of the last ice age. Randall Carlson, an independent researcher of ancient catastrophes, says he gave them himself: "five lectures" where he "talked about the younger dus, the mass extinctions, the rapid climate change." He tells it to show he was making the case years before it became widely discussed.
